name: diachronic
description: Track changes for Markdown: versions per note, word-level suggestions you accept or reject, comments, and a review sidebar.

scripts.typecheck:scripts: if test -d ../tools/obsidian-cdp; then tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json --noEmit; else echo 'typecheck:scripts uebersprungen: ../tools/obsidian-cdp fehlt'; fi
scripts.test: node scripts/check-no-abs-paths.mjs && node scripts/check-no-nul-bytes.mjs && vitest run
scripts.gate: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:test && npm run typecheck:scripts && npm test && npm run check:pure && npm run build
scripts.deploy: npm run build && cp main.js manifest.json styles.css "${OBSIDIAN_PLUGIN_DIR:?set OBSIDIAN_PLUGIN_DIR}"/

author: Johannes Kaindl
